answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the saffron of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sparrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
